searchText: Should `LightClientVoteData` contain `finalized_checkpoint` obtained from `beacon_state.finalized_checkpoint`? This is not strictly needed. The way sync works is that you (the light client) have some trusted finalized root (from showing up with it or from a previous sync). The light server then gives you a a good aggregate lightclientvote from the next light client period (which you have the expected committee proved against your previous root). This block root they the light client voted on has a state root in it so you can then get proofs about anything else you need (latest finalized, the next light client committee for sync, etc) You could cut out some proof overhead in sync by including additional fields explicitly but only marginally Makes sense. Light client protocol should be capable of delivering any portion of the state they need. this need to be updated, but the idea is very similar -- https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-specs/blob/dev/specs/phase1/light-client-sync.md instead of using shard committee attestations (dont' exist anymore) and getting the beacon block header from the shard block voted on, and all the upated fields from there you use the light client committee vote on the beacon root directly
